text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's finally the day of Yamanin Zephyr's
debut
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The question slips out. Official races are
on a
completely different level from the
scrimmages at
the academy.
choice_data_list: Your body isn't feeling stiff, is it?
Is your body feeling stiff at all?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having to race before so many eyes, all
seeking to measure her worth, while
surrounded by opponents each
determined to become a legend in their
own—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, it feels the same as always—akin to
a
harmonious breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she has no nerves
whatsoever... which
is a relief.
choice_data_list: O-Oh, really! That's good to hear,...
O-Oh, got it! That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To be fair, she has always beat to her own drum... I guess she just isn't bothered by the public gaze in general.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I know exactly what I have to do on the
turf—I
simply have to become the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Being able to focus on that alone is a
most
auspicious updraft... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me, Trainer. Watch as
I
beckon the first winds of spring!
